summary: KEEP. Acceptance ① (no command starts without quota): preflight_and_reserve refuses when stored + reserved + requested exceeds the profile ceiling (exact-number refusal pinned) or the volume lacks the bytes, and the reservation is journaled durably before any launch consumes it; the refusing path is the one the launch gate calls. Acceptance ② (active inverse data never collected): refs live from the put until after the terminal receipt — release is refused from every non-receipted state under the exact-owner fence, a digest held by any live ref row is retained by GC, and task attachments (blobs without an .effect marker) are structurally outside GC. Acceptance ③ (GC idempotent): rerunning the sweep over a swept root collects nothing, and the same sweep recovers an interrupted put (blob+marker without a ref row) — crash-safe refcount recovery that never leaves uncounted live data. P26A.1/2/3 all proven; the receipt releases reservations in the same transaction that records it, surviving a crash-reopen. Disclosed: the disk-exhausted arm is machine-tested to the shared code path (real volume exhaustion is not testable here; the quota ceiling arm proves the refusal shape); store-failure mapping reuses ArtifactError::Io with an explicit prefix because a new variant would break the undeclared router's exhaustive match. House 1098/1097/1 with only the declared plan_schema baseline; zero flake members across both full runs.
